target.statement: A.S.E contains 120 repository-level vulnerability instances, comprising 40 seed repositories and 80 mutated variants.

compute.basis: Only requires cloning/downloading the released benchmark metadata and counting instances; no LLM inference or SAST scan is needed for the 40-seed/80-mutant composition.

title: A.S.E: A Repository-Level Benchmark for Evaluating Security in AI-Generated Code
